machine_details.machine_type: Pressurized Vertical Spindle Package Dyeing Vessel

capacity.fabric_capacity: 200 kg yarn packages (approx 200 packages @ 1.0 kg each)

process_compatibility.supported_fabric_types: Cotton yarn packages, Polyester textured yarn, Wool cones, Acrylic yarn
process_compatibility.supported_dye_types: Reactive Dyes, Disperse Dyes, Acid Dyes, Indanthrene Vat Dyes
process_compatibility.supported_chemicals: Salt, Soda Ash, Caustic, Hydros, Acetic Acid, Dispersing agents
process_compatibility.suitable_processes: Yarn Package Bleaching, Dyeing, Soaping, Rewinding preparation

machine_constraints.minimum_load: 100 kg (Requires dummy packages on empty spindles to prevent bypass)
machine_constraints.pressure_restrictions: Differential pressure Delta P must stay between 0.8 and 1.5 bar
machine_constraints.fabric_restrictions: Requires rigid perforated plastic or stainless steel spring dye tubes

performance.water_consumption: 40 to 55 Liters per kg of yarn
performance.steam_consumption: 3.0 to 4.0 kg steam per kg of yarn
performance.power_consumption: 22 kW main reversible centrifugal pump motor

sensors.pressure_sensor: Dual Differential Pressure Sensor (Spindle vs Vessel)

operating_parameters.recommended_pressure: Spindle Pressure 2.5 bar | Vessel Pressure 1.5 bar (Delta P 1.0 bar)
operating_parameters.recommended_speed: Reversal Cycle: 4 min In-Out / 2 min Out-In

maintenance.daily_checks: Inspect spindle seals, check carrier locking nuts, clean main filter screen
maintenance.weekly_checks: Inspect reversal valve pneumatic cylinders, test safety relief valve
maintenance.monthly_checks: Calibrate differential pressure transmitter, inspect carrier spindles for bowing
maintenance.calibration_requirements: Bi-annual calibration of flow meter and PT100 temperature sensors

failure_information.common_faults: Liquor bypass channel formation, package tube collapsing, flow reversal valve jamming
failure_information.alarm_conditions: Delta P < 0.5 bar (bypass), Delta P > 1.8 bar (clogging), Temp deviation
failure_information.failure_causes: Uneven winding density (<0.30 g/cm³), excessive column compaction pressure
failure_information.troubleshooting: Verify package winding density (0.35 ± 0.015 g/cm³); check spindle column torque

safety.safety_limits: Max temp 135°C, Max vessel pressure 4.5 bar, Safety valve set at 4.2 bar
safety.emergency_shutdown_conditions: Delta P spike > 2.2 bar, pneumatic door seal pressure drop, main pump overload
safety.ppe_requirements: Safety glasses, heat resistant gloves, safety shoes, hard hat near overhead crane

machine_operating_rules: ASSERT package_density >= 0.32 AND package_density <= 0.38 FOR Cotton yarn
ASSERT package_density >= 0.38 AND package_density <= 0.42 FOR Polyester yarn
IF empty_spindles > 0 THEN dummy_blanking_tubes MUST BE INSTALLED
interlock_conditions: Flow reversal valve CANNOT actuate unless Main_Pump_RPM < 20% (prevents water hammer)
Door safety lock ENGAGED while Temperature > 80°C
best_operating_practices: Maintain 12-15% axial compaction when securing spindle locking nuts
Use expandable stainless spring tubes for polyester package dyeing to allow shrinkage
